text:
Olivia Chen: hey y'all :wave: went through the k8s onboarding but I don't see our staging context. `kubectl config get-contexts` only shows redwood-dev and redwood-prod. on mac m1 — did I miss something?

DevEx Bot: welcome Olivia! tagging @Sam Kim. quick checks: did you run the provider kubeconfig update step? run `echo $KUBECONFIG` and `kubectl config get-contexts -o name` to confirm.

Sam Kim: hey Olivia — staging cluster is `redwood-staging-us-west-2`. Two common issues: (1) kubeconfig files not merged (multiple files separated by colon) or (2) AWS SSO profile hasn't fetched creds. can you paste outputs?

Olivia Chen: output below:
```
$ kubectl config get-contexts -o name
redwood-dev
redwood-prod
```
`$ echo $KUBECONFIG`
`/Users/olivia/.kube/config:/Users/olivia/.kube/config-aws`

Olivia Chen: also `kubectl get ns` shows a handful but no staging.

Priya Rao: you have multiple kubeconfigs; staging context likely in `config-aws`. try `KUBECONFIG=/Users/olivia/.kube/config-aws kubectl config get-contexts -o name`. if that shows `redwood-staging-us-west-2`, merge via `kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/merged-config` then `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/merged-config` or replace `~/.kube/config` after backing up.

Sam Kim: if you use AWS SSO do `aws sso login --profile redwood` then `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name redwood-staging --region us-west-2 --profile redwood`. if context appears but `kubectl get pods -n staging` is forbidden, you'll need a RoleBinding.

Olivia Chen: ran the commands, `aws sso login` succeeded and `update-kubeconfig` added `redwood-staging-us-west-2`. now `kubectl get pods -n staging` returns: `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "arn:aws:iam::1234567890:role/Redwood-SSO-Redwood" cannot list resource "pods" in the namespace "staging"`

Priya Rao: yep that's RBAC blocking. we'll add a short-lived RoleBinding granting `view` on `staging` to your principal or group. Sam can apply.

Sam Kim: @Olivia please DM your company email so I can bind you.

Olivia Chen: olivia.chen@redwood.example.com

Sam Kim: created RoleBinding `rb-olivia-staging-view` in `staging`, bound to group `redwood-engineers` and your principal. try `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` then `kubectl get pods -n staging`.

Olivia Chen: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` -> `yes`
`kubectl get pods -n staging` now lists pods :tada:

Olivia Chen: thanks so much! I'll add a quick note to the onboarding doc about KUBECONFIG ordering and the SSO + update-kubeconfig step.

Priya Rao: please add that — saved us time. :+1:

DevEx Bot: noted and added a pointer to the onboarding doc for KUBECONFIG merge issues and AWS SSO steps in the next PR. thanks for reporting!
